mapper.sql: e.user_id AS userId, e.name AS name, d.name AS departmentName, p.name AS parentDepartmentName, jp.name AS jobPositionName, a.role AS role

JOIN account a ON a.user_id = e.user_id LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = e.department_id AND d.company_id = e.company_id LEFT JOIN department p ON p.department_id = d.parent_id AND p.company_id = e.company_id LEFT JOIN job_position jp ON jp.job_position_id = e.job_position_id AND jp.company_id = e.company_id

SELECT , pp.permission AS permission FROM page_permission pp JOIN employee e ON e.user_id = pp.user_id AND e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.is_system = 0 AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
WHERE pp.page_code = #{pageCode} AND a.role = 'MEMBER' ORDER BY e.name ASC, e.user_id ASC

SELECT , NULL AS permission FROM employee e
WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.is_system = 0 AND e.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.role = 'MASTER' ORDER BY e.name ASC, e.user_id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM page_permission pp JOIN employee e ON e.user_id = pp.user_id AND e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.is_system = 0 AND e.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN account a ON a.user_id = e.user_id AND a.role = 'MEMBER' WHERE pp.page_code = #{pageCode}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee e JOIN account a ON a.user_id = e.user_id AND a.role = 'MASTER' WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.is_system = 0 AND e.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT e.user_id AS userId, a.role AS role, e.is_system AS isSystem FROM employee e JOIN account a ON a.user_id = e.user_id WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.user_id IN
#{id}
